seeds.source: NOAA CA37A02 T-00352 (1852): open water east of the mean high water line off Potrero Point

seeds.note: Accepted 2026-11-12. Scope: this 1857 area overlaps the 1852 one almost entirely; it adds the tidal channels of Islais Creek, and covers 28.2 ha that the land seed marks as land (water wins there).
